summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, disclosing a notification from BlackRock, Inc. that its aggregate holding in Caledonia crossed a threshold under the AIM Rules. BlackRock's position increased to 6.12% of voting rights (4.83% in shares and 1.28% via financial instruments) as of June 26, 2026. This is a routine passive ownership disclosure and does not represent an activist campaign, tender offer, or any special-situation event. No board action, transaction terms, or structural changes are involved. This filing warrants no special-situation classification.
